cohort: 8874 women with data available at 0-24 hours postpartum
finding: This study established reference ranges for vital signs (pulse pressure, ROPE, heart rate, and systolic blood pressure) during the first 24 hours postpartum, which could aid in the early identification of hemodynamic compromise and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: An increase in shock index was observed among patients who had cesarean deliveries.
